All five contracts fell together, so the move is real, not an isolated print. L-007: the 21:00 forecast was right. N(1h) fell to 0.554% as the 12:00Z bar left the 1h window, and the binding N stays 1.128% (N2h/N3h). The drop in N(1h) is window arithmetic (L-006). L-005: no contract held a usable book on both sides across three sweeps, and XRP breached the spread cap. Lessons applied: L-001, L-004, L-005, L-006, L-007. L-002 and L-003 were not reached. None loosened.
